data: Does the BLEU score plateau at a beam size of 10?

The question asks whether the BLEU score plateaus at a beam size of 10. From the analysis of the figure, the BLEU score increases steadily until approximately a beam size of 10, after which it appears to level off. The caption also mentions that a beam of 12 corresponds to row 15 in Table 3, which is consistent with the trend observed in the figure. Therefore, based on the visual evidence, the BLEU score does indeed plateau at a beam size of 10.
